_comment_top: spaarkeai-assistant-enhancements-r3 task 023 (FR-09 — per-item Email parity) — seed row for the email.summarize_thread tool. EXTENDS EmailDraftToolHandler (§11 reuse-first / NFR-06 — NOT a new handler family) via the sprk_configuration 'method' discriminator (method = 'summarize_thread'); the TextRefinementHandler multi-row precedent.
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to EmailDraftToolHandler via sprk_handlerclass; the handler dispatches on sprk_configuration.method = 'summarize_thread'. Auto-discovered (ADR-010). The deterministic ADR-039 PreFilter/catalog projects the LLM-facing function name from sprk_name — NO classifier.
_comment_output_shape: FR-09 RESOLVED: the output is a PLAIN NARRATIVE summary IDENTICAL in shape to the file/document-summarize path — NOT a bespoke structured/JSON thread format. The narrative is produced through the IEmailDraftAi facade's 'summarize' preset (plain text, IsHtml=false) — the same single-shot summarise prompt/response path the compose sparkle summarise uses. The answer flows in CHAT (data.text); NO composer is opened.
_comment_obo: ADR-028 / ADR-015 MUST rule: the email subject/body is READ over the caller's OBO token via IDataverseUserClient (sprk_communication) — no app-only path. Content is tool-fetched BY communicationId; no email content enters the arguments/prompt.
_comment_eml_grounding: The tool also resolves the archived .eml document id (sprk_document flagged sprk_isemailarchive = true) over OBO and echoes it for grounding. NOTE (task-023 deviation, ADR-028): the .eml BINARY is SPE-resident and MI-written (SPE writer-identity rule); a chat-tool handler has no request HttpContext / endpoint-filter OBO gate like the eml-render endpoint, so an OBO user SPE download would 403 and an app-only download would violate the binding 'not app-only' constraint. The OBO-safe thread content is therefore the sprk_communication record body. Full-.eml-text enrichment is deferred to a future OBO-safe eml-text path.
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000000 (Read). Reads the email over OBO and produces a narrative; creates no record, opens no composer — no confirmation gate.
_comment_description_parity: Multi-row handler — sprk_description authored HERE (exempt from single-row CatalogToolDescriptionParityContractTests, matching TextRefinementHandler). Runtime parity via seed script + RoutingConsumerTypeHealthCheck.
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter.
sprk_description: Summarizes the selected email thread, addressed by communicationId, and answers IN CHAT with a plain-language narrative summary (a few clear, factual sentences) — the same shape as a file summary, NOT a structured object. Reads the email under the calling user's permissions. Use this when the user asks to summarize the email that is currently open/selected ('summarize the thread', 'what's this email about'). Opens no composer. Returns { tool, communicationId, text } — relay the narrative text to the user.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — this tool exists for the agent loop (P2), not playbook nodes.

sprk_jsonschema.title: email.summarize_thread Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: Summarizes the selected email thread in chat. Content is fetched by communicationId over OBO; NO email content is passed as an argument (ADR-015).

communicationId.description: The sprk_communication record id (GUID) of the email thread to summarize (the currently selected/open email).
The email thread that was summarized.

text.description: The plain-narrative summary (file-summarize shape) to relay in chat — NOT a structured sections object.

emlDocumentId.description: The archived .eml document id, when one exists (grounding).

sprk_configuration._comment: method discriminator — read by EmailDraftToolHandler.ResolveMethod at execution time to route to the summarize_thread path.
